name: lwc-to-agentforce-chat
description: Turn a Figma design into a Lightning Web Component that renders inside an Agentforce chat bubble. Includes a mandatory HTML preview step in the middle so you can review the design in a browser before it becomes LWC. Bundles the lwc-to-agentforce-chat skill, a read-only figma-extractor subagent, and the official Figma MCP endpoint.
